# Test that the GKWORK environment variable flag is used by go work init.

! exists go.work
go work init
exists go.work

env GKWORK=$GKPATH/src/foo/foo.work
! exists foo/foo.work
go work init
exists foo/foo.work

env GKWORK=
cd foo/bar
! go work init
stderr 'already exists'

# Create directories to make go.work files in.
-- foo/dummy.txt --
-- foo/bar/dummy.txt --
